newsitem.title: USA: Maine gov wants school districts to cooperate more.
newsitem.headline: Maine gov wants school districts to cooperate more.

text.p: At a meeting of the Greater Portland Chamber of Commerce in Maine, Gov Angus King called for greater cooperation among school districts.

The governor is asking for the cooperation to help reduce administrative costs. But King told the business group he does not want to reduce the local control of school boards. The governor added, "King may be brave, but King is not stupid."
